description: This file defines the utility object SplitUtils, which provides functions to split a string into a custom LinkedList of tokens based on spaces.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utilities.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is not empty, indicating it is valid.
